blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We use Letter Positional Probabilities (LPPs) to examine the orthographic differences between simple and complex French words. We draw from a sample of 38,000 French words scored by reaction time on a lexical decision task. We take the 5000 highest reaction time words and the 5000 lowest as a proxy for high and low word complexity groups respectively. We create 18 variables based on the structure of the words, such as length and number of syllables. We also reduce each word to a string of binary values by one-hot encoding each letter according to the 42 characters of the standard French alphabet up to a length of 25 letters. Thus, each word is represented by 42 x 25 binary characters. We then create LPPs by looking at the average binary scores for simple as opposed to complex words for all letter/positions. We find that there is a high number of LPPs that are associated with word complexity. For example, we find that most accented letters are associated with simpler words. We examine the effects of structural and LPP variables in classifiers and find that word length alone enables a classification accuracy of 77.27%, while adding the binary variables from the first 6 letter positions provided an accuracy of 83.95%. We discuss possible explanations as to how complexity could be encoded in orthography.
blocks.zh: 我们使用字母定位概率(LPPs)来检查简单和复杂的法语单词的正文差异. 我们从38 000个法语单词的样本中抽取,这些单词是按反应时间对一项词汇决定任务的。 我们分别将5000个最高反应时间词和5000个最低反应时间词作为高词组和低词组的代名词. 我们根据单词的结构创造了18个变量,例如音节的长度和数量. 我们还通过按照标准法语字母表的42个字符对每个字母进行单热编码,将每个单词减少到一串二进制值,最长可达25个字母. 因此,每个词由42×25二进制字符代表. 然后我们通过查看所有字母/位置的平均二进制分数来创建LPP. 我们发现有大量的LPP与词的复杂性有关. 例如,我们发现,大多数重音字母都与更简单的单词有关. 我们研究了分类器中结构变量和LPP变量的影响,发现单词长度就可以使分类精度达到77.27%,而从前6个字母位置添加二进制变量则提供了83.95%的精度. 我们讨论了如何在整形图中编码复杂性的可能解释。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
This paper examines French word complexity using letter positional probabilities (LPPs). In [ 9 ] it was demonstrated across three different datasets that LPPs can be used to assess English word complexity. In this study we apply the same concept to French word complexity.
The underlying hypothesis here is that there is a latent quality of words which we call word complexity. This quality can be approximated with a number of proxies such as word length, number of syllables, age of acquisition, frequency, concreteness, orthographic characteristics and reaction times on various lexical decision criteria [ 10 , 4 , 26 , 5 , 3 , 22 , 16 ] . The idea of using LPPs is that these may also be proxies for word complexity.
blocks.zh:
本文使用字母位置概率(LPP)来研究法语单词的复杂性. 在[9]中,通过三个不同的数据集证明了LPP可用于评估英语单词复杂性. 在这项研究中,我们对法语词的复杂性采用了同样的概念。
这里的基本假设是,词有潜在的质量,我们称之为词的复杂性。 这一质量可以大致与若干代词,如词长,音节数,获取年代,频率,混凝土,正体特征以及各种词汇决定标准的反应时间[10,4,26,5,3,22,16]. 使用LPP的想法是,这些也可能是词的复杂性的代词.

blocks.en: We use the reaction time on a lexical decision task as a proxy for word complexity to select a sample of 5000 short reaction time (low complexity) words and 5000 long reaction time (high complexity) words from a database of over 38000 French words. Thus, the samples are drawn from the extreme ends of the frequency distribution. In this way, we approximate a sample that represents the extreme ends of the complexity range.
blocks.zh: 我们用反应时间来完成一个词汇决定任务,作为字词复杂性的代名词,从一个超过38000个法语字的数据库中选取5000个短反应时间(低复杂)字和5000个长反应时间(高复杂)字的样本. 因此,样本是从频率分布的极端抽取的. 这样,我们大概可以得出一个样本,代表复杂性范围的极端端.

blocks.en: An important caveat that we must consider is the extent to which reaction times are a proxy for complexity. It is certainly established that reaction times are associated with the usual proxies noted above. Given that these are used as proxies for word complexity, it seems reasonable to claim that reaction times tap into significant elements of word complexity.
blocks.zh: 我们必须考虑的一个重要警告是,反应时间在多大程度上代表了复杂性。 当然可以确定,反应时间与上述通常的代理人有关。 鉴于这些是用来表示字词复杂性的代名词,因此似乎有理由声称反应时间利用了字词复杂性的重要内容。

blocks.en: We generate LPPs by ‘one-hot encoding’, for each letter position, a binary for 1 - 26 Latin characters plus 16 accented letters and ligatures. We do this for word lengths of 3 - 25 letters. The purpose of this is to represent the fine grain ’atomic’ structure of the word. We find that there are many LPPs that are highly statistically significant in distinguishing between high and low complexity words.
blocks.zh: 我们通过“一热编码”生成LPP, 对于每个字母位置, 一个二进制的拉丁字符加16个重音字母和结扎。 我们这样做是为了3 -25个字母的字长。 这样做的目的是代表这个词的细粒原子结构。 我们发现,在区分高复杂词和低复杂词方面,有许多LPP在统计学上具有高度重要性.

blocks.en: 2 Previous Work
blocks.zh: 2 以往的工作

blocks.en: This study extends the approach in [ 9 ] where LPPs were used to assess English word complexity over three datasets. In the first two datasets, 66 LPPS were found to be common as between the two datasets (p < .001), and these were then used to create a classifier that was able to correctly classify a third dataset with an accuracy of 70%. Thus, LPPs seem to carry information relating to word complexity. However, these experiments used English words. The current study attempts to find a similar phenomenon with French words.
blocks.zh: 本研究在[9]中扩展了这一方法,在这三个数据集中,用LPP来评估英文词的复杂性。 在前两个数据集中,发现66个LPPS在两个数据集之间是常见的(p < 001),然后用它们来创建一个分类器,能够正确分类第三个数据集,精度达到70%. 因此,液化石油气厂似乎载有与字词复杂性有关的信息。 然而,这些实验使用了英语单词. 目前的研究试图用法语词汇来发现类似现象.

blocks.en: The approach that is most similar to the current study is that exemplified by [ 25 ] , in which phonotactic segments of words were used rather than individual letters. The idea here is that phonotactic segments that are more common in a language are more easily recognised. In that study, it was shown that phonotactic segments that are common in a language are more easily recognised in spoken words than those that are not, and this facilitates word recognition. However, there is an opposing influence in that, if there is a high density of words that have similar phonotactic segments, recognition time can slow due to the effort required to disambiguate the target word from other competing words.
blocks.zh: 与目前研究最相似的方法是用[25]作为例子,其中使用了词的发音部分而不是单个字母. 这里的想法是,在一种语言中比较常见的光谱片段更容易被识别. 该研究显示,语言中常见的口语部分比非口语部分更容易识别,这有利于词的识别。 然而,有相反的影响,如果有类似光谱片段的词密度高,由于需要努力将目标词与其他相竞争的词区分开来,识别时间可能会放慢.

blocks.en: Phonological segment recognition has been found to occur in infants as young as 9 months [ 15 ] . In that study, infants were found to be able to recognise phonotactic segments from their own language. Similarly, native speakers of Dutch use phonotactic segments to separate individual words in fluent speech [ 19 ] . There is evidence that phonotactic probability also affects word production. In [ 24 ] , subjects named pictures with more probable phonotactic segments words more quickly than words with lower phonotactic probability. However, those target words with high numbers of orthographical neighbours where the initial phoneme is shared by the target word (high onset density), were responded to more slowly than target words with fewer orthographic neighbours sharing an initial phoneme (low onset density). Finally, in [ 12 ] , those nonwords that contained high probability phonological segments were judged to be more ’wordlike’ than nonwords made of low-probability segments.
blocks.zh: 现已发现,在9个月的婴儿中,人们会认识到有心理特征。 该研究发现,婴儿能够从自己的语言中识别出磷酸盐。 同样,荷兰语的母语人也使用声带片段,在流利的演讲中将单个单词分开[19]. 有证据表明,光学概率也影响到文字生产. 在 [24] 中,被试者以更可能发声的片段词命名图片,比发声概率较低的片段词更快. 然而,那些拥有大量正交邻居的目标字,最初的电话是目标字共用的(高发密度),其响应速度比目标字慢,只有较少的正交邻居拥有初始电话(低发密度)。 最后,在[12]中,那些含有高概率的声乐片段的非词被认为比由低概率片段构成的非词更像词.

blocks.en: In [ 23 ] an algorithm was designed to score synonyms by simplicity on a continuous scale. The training took place with two sources with graded levels of vocabulary for younger/older students and French as a foreign language students. It was evaluated by comparing the rankings of synonyms by simplicity coded manually. They used 300-dimension word embeddings as features. Here the embeddings were vector representations of the word environment in which a target word appears in a large training corpus. They combined word embeddings combined with number of characters, number of phonemes and log frequency. In isolation, embeddings perform better than other features, but the best set of predictors was number of characters and + log frequency.
blocks.zh: 在[23]中,一个算法被设计成通过连续尺度上的简单来得分同义词. 培训有两个来源,为年轻/老年学生提供分级词汇,为外语学生提供法语。 通过手动编码的简单来比较同义词的排名来评价它. 他们使用300个嵌入词作为特征. 这里的嵌入是矢量表示一个大训练体中出现目标词的词环境. 它们结合了词嵌入,结合了字符数,电话数和日志频率. 孤立地说,嵌入的性能优于其他特性,但最好的一套预测器是字符数和+日志频率.

blocks.en: In [ 13 ] , using the same graded corpora as used in [ 23 ] , the authors calculated nine structural variables such as number of characters, number of syllables, phonemes etc. They also used orthographic neighbourhood, phoneme-grapheme correspondence - based on a three point scale. The second set of features was based on morphology, such as number of morphemes, suffixation, prefixation etc. A third set of features consisted of two measures of polysemy. Finally, they include two measures of word frequency. In both corpora, frequency was the feature with the highest correlation with complexity. The overall finding was that word frequency provided more signal than the other variables and the addition of other variables provided only marginal improvement. They found that intermediate classes are the most difficult to classify, with the extremes more easy. The authors acknowledged that the labels may themselves have been noisy, given that the same word may be inlcuded in or excluded from different corpora based on textbook selection and teaching approaches. They also point out that the morphology data may have been inaccurate.
blocks.zh: 在[13]中,作者使用与[23]中使用的同一等级的corpora,计算出九个结构变量,如字符数,音节数,电话数等. 他们也使用正交相邻,电话-图书通信——基于三分比例. 第二组特征基于形态学,如morphemes数量,后缀,前缀等. 第三组特征包括两个多聚体测量。 最后,它们包括两个词频的度量. 在两个科波拉语中,频率都是与复杂度关系最高的特征. 总的发现是,文字频率提供的信号比其他变量多,加上其他变量只能提供微小的改进。 他们发现中产阶级最难分类,极端比较容易分类. 提交人承认,标签本身可能很吵,因为根据教科书的挑选和教学方法,同一字可能融入或被排除在不同的公司之外。 他们还指出形态学数据可能不准确.

blocks.en:
In [ 1 ] the authors used word embeddings in order to capture word meanings. The idea, as in other work using embeddings, is that a word is given its function in relation to other words, the difference being that they include a context for each word in their word embedding procedure. Thus, the word ‘run’ has 10 entries, and this includes two noun
forms and eight verbs. The lowest level of language learner (A1) learns the word in the context "He can run very fast" but at C2, "He would like to run for mayor". The procedure used involved presenting each target word with a contextual sentence. Contextual embeddings improved the Macro-F1 score across A1 - C2 language learning levels by 22 percentage points in comparison to using frequency and word length alone. An attempt to use multilingual BERT to score a corpus of French words using the model trained on English words was less successful, with only the beginner word class being correctly scored. The authors mentioned possible reasons for this as being differences in morphology between English and French and the lack of availability of French lexical sources.
blocks.zh:
在[1]中,作者使用嵌入词来捕捉词义. 与其他使用嵌入法的作品一样,这个想法是赋予一个单词相对于其他单词的功能,区别在于它们在其词嵌入程序中包含每个单词的上下文. 因此,“运行”一词有10个条目,其中包括两个名词
形式和8个动词。 语言学习水平最低的(A1)在上下文"他可以跑得非常快"中学习这个词,但在C2中"他想竞选市长". 所采用的程序包括提出每个目标词,并附有一个上下文。 上下文嵌入使整个A1-C2语言学习水平的Macro-F1分数与单使用频率和单字长度相比提高了22个百分点. 试图使用多语言的BERT用英语单词训练的模型来评分一连串的法语单词并不成功,只有初学者的单词课才得到正确的评分. 提交人提到可能的原因是,英语和法语在形态上存在差异,而且缺乏法语词汇来源。

blocks.en: Alfter et al. [ 2 ] examined word-sense difficulty as perceived among French native and non-native speakers. Participants ranked word senses as presented in individual sentences from easiest to most difficult. There was a high degree of correlation between the native and non-native French speakers. Furthermore, the word sense difficulty rankings were broadly correlated with vocabulary difficulty established in language-learning environments. A subsequent attempt to find an association between word-sense difficulty and the complexity of dictionary definitions was inconclusive.
blocks.zh: 阿尔夫特等人. [2] 审查了讲法语的当地人和非当地人所认为的语气困难。 参与者将单个句子中的单词感知从最简单到最难排序. 讲母语的法国人与讲非母语的法国人之间有着高度的相关性。 此外,感官难度排名与语言学习环境中确定的词汇难度有着广泛关联。 随后试图在词感困难和词典定义的复杂性之间寻找联系,但都没有定论。

blocks.en: In [ 14 ] , subjects were given a prime and were subsequently given a lexical decision task. The format of the primes, for a given target ABCDE, was %BCDE, A%CDE, AB%DE, ABC%E and ABCD%E. They found that some partial word primes were more effective than others at eliciting the correct response. The important factor was the letter positional frequency. Where a given letter is unlikely to appear in a given position in words in the language in general, there is less room to move in terms of the decision as to the correct target, and so the prime is more efficient.
blocks.zh: 在[14]中,主体被赋予了质数,并随后被赋予了一种词汇决定任务. 给定目标 ABCDE 的质数格式为 %BCDE, A%CDE, AB%DE, ABC%E和 ABCD%E 。 他们发现,有些部分词质比其他词更能引起正确的反应。 重要因素是字母位置频率。 如果一个给定的字母在一般语言的文字中不太可能在某个特定的位置出现,那么在正确目标的决定上,移动的余地就更少了,因此质素效率更高.

blocks.en: In [ 17 ] , it was found that more frequent words are ‘better formed’. A word is well formed if its sequence of letters, based on a trigram search algorithm, is probable given other sequences in words in the language. They also found that more frequent words had more orthographic neighbours.
blocks.zh: 在[17]中,人们发现更频繁的词语是"更好的形成". 如果一个词的字母序列基于三格搜索算法,在语言中可能给其他的词序列带来其他的序列,那么一个词就很好形成. 他们还发现,比较频繁的文字有较多的正字形邻居.

blocks.en: In [ 8 ] , a compression algorithm (CAFTS) designed to speed up text search was used to compress texts from various languages to approximately 41% of their original size. The algorithm is based on a series of dictionaries of trigrams. Using the algorithm, French had a compression ratio of 3.18 bits/character, which was lower on average than several other languages, with an average across 8 languages of 3.31. We reproduce the table below as Table 1 as it includes the compression data for several languages and compression ratios.

blocks.en: 3 Data and Methods
blocks.zh: 3 数据和方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Data
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据

blocks.en: The data for this study comes from [ 11 ] . This source contains 38,840 French words and 38,840 non-words. The study was designed to determine the time taken to decide whether a given word was a real word or a non word. We used the z scores for the reaction times to rank the words.
blocks.zh: 本研究的数据来自[11]. 这一来源包含38,840个法语单词和38,840个非词. 该研究旨在确定一个特定词是真词还是非词需要的时间. 我们用反应时间的z分数来排序词.

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Cleaning
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据清理

blocks.en: With 38,840 words, we undertake the following data cleaning steps.
blocks.zh: 用38,840字,我们采取以下数据清理步骤。

blocks.en: • convert characters to lowercase. The original words were in lowercase, but this step was undertaken to ensure there were no capitals • remove all words containing any character other than those of the 42-character standard French alphabet • remove lemmas with non-alphabetical characters • remove words shorter than 3 characters or longer than 25 characters

blocks.en: After these operations we are left with 38,287 words. Of these, we extract the 5000 with the lowest reaction times and the 5000 with the highest reaction times, giving us a sample of n = 10000.
blocks.zh: 在这些行动之后,我们只剩下38 287个字。 其中,提取反应时间最低的5000,反应时间最高的5000,得出n=1000的样本.

blocks.en: 3.3 Variables
blocks.zh: 3.3 变量

blocks.en: The fundamental analysis in this study is based on LPPs. The method of calculating these is as follows.
blocks.zh: 本研究中的基本分析基于LPP. 计算方法如下。

blocks.en: For any word of up to 25 letters, each letter in positions 1…25 is represented by 42 binary variables, each of which is a binary representing the presence/absence of one of the 42 letters of the alphabet. Thus, we have 25 positions × 42 alphabetic variables. For each position, if a given letter of the alphabet is in that position, the binary for that letter takes the value of 1 for that letter and 0 for all other 41 letters in that position. For example, for the word ’cat’, with ’c’ in the first position (the first 42 variables) the letter ’c’ takes a binary value of 1 and the other letters take a 0. For position two (variables 43 - 84), the letter ’a’ takes a binary value of 1, and the other letters take a value of 0. Finally, for position 3 (variables 85 - 126), the ’t’ takes a binary value of one and all other letters take a value of 0. For the remaining letter positions from 4 - 25, all values = 0.
blocks.zh: 对于任何最多25个字母的单词,在1..25位置的每个字母由42个二进制变量代表,每个二进制变量是一个二进制变量,代表字母表42个字母中的一个字母存在/不存在. 因此,我们有25个位置×42个字母变量。 对于每个位置,如果一个字母表的给定字母处于该位置,该字母的二进制值为该字母的1,该位置的所有其他41个字母的0. 例如,对 ' cat ' 一词来说, " c " 位于第一位置(前42个变量),字母 ' c ' 的二进制值为1,其他字母为0。 对于第2位(可变43 - 84),字母 'a ' 的二进制值为1,其他字母的值为0. 最后,对于第3位(可变值85 - 126),“不”取一个二进制值,所有其他字母取0。 对于4 - 25的剩余字母位置,所有值=0.

blocks.en: After Bonferroni correction, there are 163 variables that are significant at the p<.01 level. These are reproduced at Appendix A . Inspection of the table shows that several of the standard word complexity measures are significantly discriminative of the high and low frequency groups, with the top 12 most significant variables being complexity measures. Of the 163 significant variables, 145 are LPPs, and all structural variables were found to be significant.
blocks.zh: 在Bonferroni校正后,有163个变量在p<01水平上是显著的. 这些案文转载于附录A。 对表格的检查表明,一些标准字词复杂度计量对高频和低频组有显著的区别,其中前12个最重要的变量是复杂度计量. 在163个重要变量中,145个是LPP,所有结构变量都被发现是显著的.

blocks.en: In order to contextualise the results for the LPPs, we should consider that the average word length of the low complexity group is 6.69 and that of the high complexity group is 9.77. What this means is that letter positions above 6 are more likely to be significant purely because their presence is indicative of greater length, and length is highly associated with complexity. This is why the first 27 significant LPPs are from positions >6. We will examine the effects of this below when we create classifiers from the LPP data. At this stage, we will examine what is happening in the first 6 positions because these are more properly associated with orthography than length.
blocks.zh: 为了将LPP的结果背景化,我们应当考虑低复杂性组的平均字长为6.69,高复杂性组的平均字长为9.77. 这意味着,6级以上的字母位置更有可能是显著的,纯粹因为其存在表明长度较大,而且长度与复杂性密切相关。 正因为如此,前27名重要的LPP来自 >6的位置。 当我们从液化石油酸盐数据中创建分类器时,我们将在下文中审查这一点的影响。 在现阶段,我们将审查头6个职位的情况,因为这些职位与整形术比长度更恰当。

blocks.en: In [ 20 ] it was found that that consonants play a more important role in English word recognition during reading than vowels. In [ 6 ] the study design involved target words with either consonants in first, thrd and fifth place (e.g., acero), or vowels in the same positions (e.g., farol). Primes consisted of the actual letters in those positions (a,c,o/f,r,l), voewls/consonants that did not appear in the word (l,u,i/t,s,b), or by the actual word (acero/farol). Using measurements of Event Related Potentials, it was found that the consonant primes had a similar Event Related Potentials effects to the actual word, while vowel primes had effects similar to the unrelated primes. Thus, there is some evidence that lexical processing may be different for the vowels as opposed to consonants. Brain activation has been found to be different in relation to vowel and consonant in several contexts [ 7 ] . Again, the evidence from the research is that there are possible reasons why vowels and consonants are differentially associated with complexity. However, there is no direct evidence of a link between vowels/consonants and word complexity.
blocks.zh: 在[20]中,发现辅音在读音时在英语单词识别中比元音的作用更重要. 在[6]中,研究设计涉及目标词,或者在第一,三音节和第五位(如acero)有对齐,或者在相同位置(如farol)有元音. 原始内容包括这些位置上的实际字母(a,c,o/f,r,l),未出现在单词中的voewls/consonants(l,u,i/t,s,b),或实际单词(aero/faro). 利用对事件相关潜能的测量,发现对应质素具有与实际词相似的事件相关潜能效应,而元音质素具有与无关质素相似的效果. 因此,有一些证据表明,对元音的词典处理可能不同于对调. 大脑激活在元音上被发现是不同的,在几种情况下是相容的[7]. 同样,研究的证据表明,元音和辅音与复杂性有不同关联的可能原因. 然而,没有直接证据表明元音/协音符与单词复杂性之间存在联系.

blocks.en: The results above indicate that there are significant variables that are likely to be able to be used to create classifiers to distinguish between low and high complexity words. By introducing different sets of variables, we can determine which variables carry the greatest signal. On the basis of this, we can determine whether the signals in the data described above are merely statistical phenomena, or whether there is something about the orthography of French words that carries information about word complexity.
blocks.zh: 以上结果显示,有一些重大的变量有可能被用来创建分类器来区分低复杂词和高复杂词. 通过引入不同的变量组合,我们可以确定哪些变量具有最大的信号. 在此基础上,我们可以确定上述数据中的信号是否仅仅是统计现象,或者是否对法语单词的拼写有某种内容,含有关于单词复杂性的信息.

blocks.en: The results show that Length alone accounts for 77.27% of correct classifications. All three classifiers score the same with this one variable, suggesting a high degree of monotonicity. All classifiers have the same distribution of errors, with sensitivity = 68.30% and specificity = 86.24
blocks.zh: 结果显示,仅长度就占正确分类的77.27%。 这三个分类者都与这个变量得分相同,说明高度单调. 所有分类器的错误分布相同,敏感度=68.30%,特异性=86.24。

blocks.en: The Structural variables, which include Length, attain a classification accuracy of 77.85% with the neural network. Given the small improvement from Length alone, the structural variables other than length add very little to the signal.

blocks.en: The Structural and All Positions features boost these results to 81.11%, with the Neural Network, indicating that the positional data carry significant information. The Random Forest results are lower than the RF result for All Positions features without the Structural features, indicating that there may be some degradation in classifier accuracy due to high levels of redundancy.
blocks.zh: 结构与所有位置特征将这些结果提升至81.11%,神经网络显示位置数据载有重要信息. 随机森林结果低于无结构特征的所有位置的RF结果,这表明由于冗余程度高,分类器的准确性可能有所降低.

blocks.en: The highest accuracy is achieved by the First 6 Positions + Length in the Random Forest at 83.95%. This is marginally higher than All Positions on their own at 83.64%. What this indicates is that there is inherent length data in the All Positions data (due to the mere presence of positional data at positions > 6), but the purely orthographic data in the First 6 positions carries a significant signal. When we add the Length variable to the First 6 Positions features we include the important orthographical information as well as the length information.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: We have seen that there are LPPs that are highly statistically associated with complexity. We have also seen that there are patterns of vowels, consonants and articulation phenomena that are associated with complexity. The indication is that there is information encoded in orthography that is beyond mere words structural information. Importantly, this information can be used to determine the simplicity/complexity of words. A classifier with LPPs from the first 6 positions along with word length was found to be the most predictive of word complexity out of a number of feature sets, including one consisting of all positions.
blocks.zh: 我们看到,有些地方的液化石油气厂在统计学上与复杂性密切相关。 我们还看到,存在着与复杂性相关的元音,调和和表达现象的规律. 其表示是,有些信息编码在正文中,超出了单纯的单词结构信息. 重要的是,这种信息可用来确定词语的简单/复杂性。 从前6个位置加上字长的LPP分类器被发现是一些功能集中最能预测字词复杂性的,包括一个由所有位置组成的功能集.

blocks.en: We can draw from these observations that there is something in orthography that carries a signal associated with complexity. Certainly length also carries a signal, but, as we have seen, combining length with positional data provides the most robust signal.
blocks.zh: 我们可以从这些观察中推断出,在矫形学中有些东西带有与复杂性相关的信号. 当然长度也带有信号,但正如我们所看到的那样,长度与位置数据相结合,提供了最强的信号。

blocks.en: In reviewing the work on phonotactic probability, we noted above that phonotactic probability is an important influence on the way words are processed, both in producing speech and understanding written and spoken speech. In the current study we posit that letter positional probabilities, rather than phonotactic probabilities, carry information about word complexity.
blocks.zh: 在审查关于发声概率的工作时,我们在上面指出,发声概率对文字处理方式有重要影响,既能产生语音,也能理解书面和口头的语音。 在当前的研究中,我们假设字母定位概率,而不是假象概率,包含关于字词复杂性的信息。

blocks.en: We also noted that position is important. In [ 14 ] above, we noted similarly that speakers of a language are sensitive to the frequencies at which letters occur at different positions. Thus, given a prime of %BCDE, and a prime of A%CDE and a target of ABCDE, the first prime will be more efficient than the second if ’A’ in first position is less frequent in the language and ’B’ in second position. Again, this overlaps with the current study.
blocks.zh: 我们还注意到这一立场是重要的。 在上文[14]中,我们同样注意到,说一种语言的人对在不同位置出现信件的频率敏感。 因此,鉴于% BCDE 的质数,以及A% CDE 的质数和ABCDE 的目标,如果“A”在第一位置上不太常见,而“B”在第二位置上,那么第一个质数将比第二个质数更有效。 这再次与目前的研究重叠。

blocks.en: The general approach of the majority of discussed studies is that native language users are sensitive to the atomic structure of words. The current study does not disagree with this, but the fundamental question is about word complexity. In the current study, the two extremes of the complexity word sample were chosen on the basis of a lexical decision experiment, and this means that the sample instantiates a phenomenon about word recognition that is similar to the other probability-based studies. The major difference is that the current study, after creating the sample based on lexical decisions, asks what it is about the structure of words at the letter level that distinguishes between simple and complex words. The latter use the structure of words to explain lexical decision criteria. In short, the process of the current study and the other studies is reversed. This is the fundamental difference between the two approaches. However, none of these, including the current study, directly address what is possibly the more interesting question: given that the structure of words carries significant information, what explains how words evolved to have such a structure? The question here is not whether complex words have a different structure compared to simple words, as we have already established this. The question is why this should be so. Although a full analysis of this is beyond the scope of this paper, this is an important issue to address.
blocks.zh: 大多数讨论过的研究的一般方法是,母语使用者对词的原子结构很敏感. 目前的研究对此没有异议,但根本的问题是字词的复杂性. 在当前的研究中,复杂字样的两个极端是依据一个词法决定实验来选择的,这意味着样本即时将一个类似于其他概率学研究的词识别现象. 主要的区别在于,目前的研究,在根据词典决定创建样本后,问到在字母一级区分简单和复杂词的词的结构是什么. 后者使用词的结构来解释词汇决定标准. 简言之,目前的研究过程和其他研究被逆转. 这是这两种方法的根本区别。 然而,其中没有任何一个,包括目前的研究,直接涉及一个可能更有趣的问题:鉴于词的结构带有重要的信息,什么解释词是如何演变成这样的结构的? 这里的问题不是复杂词与简单的词相比是否有不同的结构,我们已经确立了这一点. 问题是为什么应该这样。 虽然对此的全面分析超出了本文件的范围,但这是一个需要处理的重要问题。

blocks.en: One possibility is that words change over time and their orthography follows. A possible method for this to take place was given by Zipf [ 27 ] . He found that pronunciation changes over time according to how frequently the word is used. The idea here is that we look for ways to reduce our effort in communication, so words that are used more often are likely to suffer simplification because there they will be recognised without highly complex articulation forms because they are so common. The argument from Zipf is that 1) a given locution is used often, 2) the phonemes are repeated often due to frequent use 3), ’shortcuts’ in articulation take place, but because of the frequency of use, other speakers of the language still understand the locution 4), phonetic ’weakening’ takes place, 5) the weakening becomes conventional 6) the lexical form of the original form is altered. Thus, more frequent terms become more easy to pronounce over time.
blocks.zh: 一种可能性是,词语随时间而变化,其正字法随之而来. Zipf[27]提供了进行这项工作的可能方法。 他发现发音随时间变化而变化,这取决于这个词的使用频率. 这里的想法是,我们寻找减少我们交流努力的方法,因此,更经常使用的词语很可能受到简化,因为在那里,人们会认识到这些词语,而不用非常复杂的表述形式,因为这些词语非常常见。 Zipf的论据是:1) 给定的locution经常使用,2) 电话频频重复,因为频繁使用3), 'shortcuts ' in expressions ' 发生,但是由于使用频率,其他语言的讲者仍然理解locution 4), 口语 'weaking ' 发生,5) 弱化变成常规的6) 原始形式的词汇形式被改变. 因此,随着时间推移,更频繁的术语变得更加容易宣布。

blocks.en: There is one seemingly contradictory finding from [ 21 ] found that across 200 word meanings from 87 Indo-European languages, common words were less likely to change. However, this is consistent with Zipf’s argument in that we might consider that the simplified words, once having achieved their simplified forms, represent collections of phonemes that are the easiest to articulate in the language. There is no behavioural reason for changing them from this form.
blocks.zh: 有一种似乎自相矛盾的结论从[21]中发现,在87种印欧语言的200个词的含义中,常见的词不太可能改变. 然而,这与Zipf的论点是一致的,即我们可能认为,简化的词语一旦实现了简化的形式,就代表了最容易用语言表达的电话集。 没有任何行为上的理由改变这种形式。

blocks.en: The implication here is that, because the simplification process took place over time, the now simple words had a more complex phonological structure at some time in the past. The words that were complex in the past and remain complex now represent the default level of complexity, and those that have become simplified represent the changed words a simplified new phonology. This suggests that the significant LPP variables are picking up on a change that has occurred over time. It is not a case that there is was initially a structural difference between simple and complex words, but it is true that the structural difference emerged over time.
blocks.zh: 这里的含义是,由于简化过程是随着时间推移而发生的,现在的简单词在过去的某个时候有比较复杂的音效结构. 过去复杂且依然复杂的词,现在代表了默认的复杂性水平,而已经简化的词,则代表了变换后的词,是一种简化的新音. 这表明,随着时间推移而发生的变化,主要的液化石油气变数正在上升。 起初简单和复杂的词有结构上的区别,但结构上的差别确实随着时间推移而出现,这并非一个案例.

blocks.en: Hypothetically, the reason that there are significant LPPs is that the simplification process is not arbitrary. The words that are more common change in a way that is systematic for a given language. As [ 17 ] found, words that have a highly probable (more likely) form within the language are more frequent, as are words with more orthographic neighbours.
blocks.zh: 假想,存在显著的LPP的原因是简化过程不是任意的. 以系统化的方式对某一语言进行更常见的词变. 正如[17]发现的那样,语言中具有极可能(更可能)形态的文字更为频繁,与更多的正体邻居的文字也更为频繁.

blocks.en: Finally, we need to consider the possibility that the concept of complexity we have been using is actually frequency. As noted above, frequency is often used as a proxy for complexity. We have used a sample consisting of what we have taken to be high and low complexity words. However it is most likely that these also represent the extremes of the frequency range. It is theoretically possible to test for frequency effects by including in the modeling procedure a measure of frequency (although choosing what corpus to base this on might be problematic). Again, this is a possible avenue of enquiry in subsequent work.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们需要考虑我们所使用的复杂性概念实际上是频率的可能性。 如上所述,频率经常被用作复杂性的代名词. 我们使用了由我们所认为的高度和低度复杂性词组成的样本。 然而,这些也很可能代表频率范围的极端。 从理论上讲,通过在建模程序中包括一个频率度量法来测试频率效应是可能的(尽管选择以什么为基准可能存在问题)。 在今后的工作中,这也是一个可能的调查途径。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This study has examined the role of LPPs in carrying a simplicity/complexity signal in French words. We examined the distribution of LPPs in simple as opposed to complex words. We found that there were 145 LPPs that were significant out of a potential cohort of 441. Because the average length of simple words was 6.69, we focused on the first 6 positions because we wished to reduce the confounding effect of length of LPPs in positions >6. We also found that several structural variables were associated with complexity, with length being particularly predictive of complexity in our sample.
blocks.zh: 这项研究研究了液化石油气在用法语表达简单/复杂信号方面的作用。 我们以简单而不是复杂的措辞审查了液化石油气的分布。 我们发现,在441个潜在群体中,有145个LPP是重要的。 由于简单字的平均长度为6.69,所以我们把重点放在前6个位置上,因为我们希望减少在位置 >6的液化石油气厂长度的混乱效应。 我们还发现,若干结构变量与复杂性有关,长度对我们样本的复杂性特别具有预测性。

blocks.en: We found that there were a number of phenomena associated with LPPs in relation to complexity. We found that 5 out of 6 of the significant LPPs containing an accented letter were associated with lower complexity, while 6 out of 6 of the significant LPPs containing an unaccented letter were associated with higher complexity. The overall finding was that there are significant differences in the orthography of simple as opposed to complex words.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,就复杂性而言,存在一些与低排放污染物有关的现象。 我们发现,6个含有重音字母的重要液化石油气厂中的5个与更低的复杂性有关,6个含有未重音字母的重要液化石油气厂中的6个与更复杂有关。 总体调查结果是,简单字与复杂字的拼写有显著差异.

blocks.en: We went on to create classifiers using LPPs and structural data as features to predict binary simple and complex words. We found that length alone achieves an accuracy of 77.27%. Additional structural variables added little to classification accuracy. The best classifier achieved an accuracy of 83.95% and consisted of the first 6 LPP features plus Length. We concluded from this that both orthography and length are significant features associated with complexity.
blocks.zh: 我们继续利用LPP和结构数据创建分类器,作为预测二进制简单和复杂的词的特性. 我们发现,仅长度就达到了77.27%的精确度。 其他结构变量对分类准确性几乎没有增加。 最好的分类器达到83.95%的精度,包括前6个LPP特性加长度. 我们从这个结论中得出结论,对形和长度都是与复杂性有关的重要特征。

blocks.en: The question we went on to examine is how orthography can encode complexity. Certainly it is conventionally accepted that word length is associated with complexity, and in the current study it was indeed the variable most closely associated with complexity. However, positing the idea that the placement of individual letters is predictive of complexity is significantly more controversial.
blocks.zh: 我们接着研究的问题是 矫形术如何编码复杂性。 当然,人们通常认为,字长与复杂性有关,在当前的研究中,它确实是与复杂性最密切相关的变量。 然而,假定单个字母的放置具有预测复杂性,则争议性大得多。

blocks.en: We considered an explanation from Zipf that more common words become simplified over time due to articulatory economy. The important point here for our purposes is that simplicity is associated with frequency in that words that are repeated often become simplified.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑了Zipf的一个解释,即由于动画经济,更常见的词语随着时间推移而变得简化. 就我们的目的而言,这里的重要一点是,简洁与频率有关,因为重复的文字往往变得简化。

blocks.en: We observed that the question of the association between vowel/consonant patterns and complexity may be worth considering in subsequent work, as is the possibility that there may be a difficulty in disentangling the difference between word complexity and word frequency.
blocks.zh: 我们观察到,元音/谐音图案和复杂度之间的关联问题可能值得在随后的工作中加以考虑,同样,可能难以区分词的复杂性和词频的区别.
